data.turoyo: Xori Brahim: B kulle stene. Maqṣat i bəlʕaziye sayminawo, mibalʕəzinawo, latwo mede.
data.translation: Chorepiscopus Brahim: All of them too. The point was that we used to have fun, amuse ourselves; there was nothing else.

rationale: First Detransitive Infectum-wa cell; one subject-oriented amusement context in a habitual past. Reader context carried a reference prefix, excluded from the verbatim quotation. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation.

summary: New sense 1: sich amüsieren, sich unterhalten (Detrans.)
rationale: Single mibalʕəzinawo token describes subject-oriented amusement without an overt b-marked partner. Retain the inherited quadriliteral stem I.

data.turoyo: Kəzza i dəbbe lu ṣaydo, kfoyəš u kurəko w i kačke lalġul. Huwe w i kačke, šuġlo latte. Hol ʕaṣriye kəmbalʕzi b ḥḏoḏe. <...>
data.translation: Wenn die Bärin aber auf die Jagd ging, so blieb der Jüngling und das Mädchen zu Hause, und da sie nichts zu tun hatten, spielten sie mit einander bis zum Abend. <...>

rationale: Thin Infectum cell; human reciprocal participants and full temporal context beside the inherited cat-and-mouse example.

summary: The plural subject is the youth and girl; b-ḥḏoḏe marks reciprocal partners, matching the inherited b-government. The time limit hol ʕaṣriye supplies duration, while kəmbalʕzi participates in the recurrent narrative sequence.
The nearby sleeping arrangements do not independently establish a sexual meaning for the verb. The edition’s spielten and the existing broad play/schäkern gloss suffice.
The inherited quadriliteral lexeme remains under stem I. No new stem, box, collocation or sense is needed.
Round 1 active reciprocal b-ḥḏoḏe play contrasts with Jan mibalʕəzinawo without an overt partner; the preceding i bəlʕaziye sayminawo supports amusement.
The i-vocalism provisionally supports Detransitive; -nawo gives the first-person plural past pattern. No change to the glossary’s inherited stem I classification or separate sexual sense.
Confirm mibalʕəzinawo as productive Detransitive rather than an active vowel variant; one token supports the proposed section provisionally.
Two human partners in reciprocal b-ḥḏoḏe illustrate the existing play/dallying gloss, without a separate romance or sexual sense.
